title: USGS National Hydrography
description: Cloud-native distribution of the USGS National Hydrography Dataset (NHD) High Resolution stream network, covering all 50 states, DC, and Pacific/Caribbean territories. Includes the full NHD flowline network with Strahler stream order attached, a nationwide perennial-streams subset, and NHDPlus High Resolution flowlines with network value-added attributes (drainage area, slope, routing) for the units where stream order is reliably computed.
